items.title: Father of fallen Marine is against Trump’s proposed arch
items.author: Associated Press
items.content: <article>For many veterans and their families, and the loved ones of others buried at Arlington National Cemetery, President Donald Trump’s proposed 250-foot (76-meter) arch has no place so close to the burial grounds. Bart Collart, father of Cpl. Spencer R. Collart, a young Marine who died at 21 trying to save fellow crew members in a 2023 Osprey crash in Australia, would see it as “dirtying hallowed ground.”</article>

items.title: ICE came to meatpacking country in Kansas. Then voters went to the polls
items.author: Associated Press
items.content: <article>In the 2024 election, it was Republicans’ message on immigration that sent Donald Trump back to the White House. But this time around, it seems that very issue is what turned some parts of rural America from deep red to blue, like Ford County in rural western Kansas. In this year’s midterm election, this county was part of that blue wave that flipped Senate and House seats across the country.</article>
